cards.q: Drugs that cause secondary osteoporosis: list all
cards.a: Glucocorticoids, phenytoin

cards.q: Determinants of peak bone mass: list all
cards.a: Inheritance, estrogen and androgens, physical activity, dietary calcium

cards.q: Primary regulators of adult bone mass: list all
cards.a: Physical activity, reproductive endocrine status, calcium intake
Osteoclast activity predominates; resorption exceeds formation

cards.q: Osteoblast response to calcitriol in osteoporosis
cards.a: Impaired
